plain_text:
Artificial light from electronic devices, homes, streetlights,
vehicles, and buildings creates light pollution. This can cause
problems for people and animals.
semantic_text: Artificial light from electronic devices, homes, streetlights, vehicles, and buildings creates light pollution. This can cause problems for people and animals.

plain_text:
Exposure to artificial light at night affects your body's
melatonin production. Melatonin is a hormone that signals it's
time to go to sleep. Poor sleep can affect your focus, judgment,
memory, and other bodily processes.
semantic_text: Exposure to artificial light at night affects your body's melatonin production. Melatonin is a hormone that signals it's time to go to sleep. Poor sleep can affect your focus, judgment, memory, and other bodily processes.

plain_text:
Bright electric lights can also affect birds that migrate at
night. These birds can become confused and may fly into
buildings, communication towers, and other structures. The
U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service estimates that nearly 7 million
birds die each year from colliding with communication
towers at night.
semantic_text: Bright electric lights can also affect birds that migrate at night. These birds can become confused and may fly into buildings, communication towers, and other structures. The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service estimates that nearly 7 million birds die each year from colliding with communication towers at night.

plain_text:
Keep your room dark for at least
9 to 10 hours a night.
semantic_text: Keep your room dark for at least 9 to 10 hours a night.

plain_text:
Install room-darkening shades
on your windows.
semantic_text: Install room-darkening shades on your windows.

plain_text:
Turn off the lights and electronic
devices in the bedroom when
you are sleeping. Avoid watching
television, using your phone, or
working on the computer right
before you shut your eyes.
semantic_text: Turn off the lights and electronic devices in the bedroom when you are sleeping. Avoid watching television, using your phone, or working on the computer right before you shut your eyes.

plain_text:
If you get up in middle of the
night to use the bathroom, for
example, use a dim red nightlight
instead of the regular room light.
Red light suppresses melatonin
production less than other
wavelengths.
semantic_text: If you get up in middle of the night to use the bathroom, for example, use a dim red nightlight instead of the regular room light. Red light suppresses melatonin production less than other wavelengths.

plain_text:
Do not take melatonin tablets
unless directed by your health
care provider. Melatonin can
disrupt your circadian rhythm
further.
semantic_text: Do not take melatonin tablets unless directed by your health care provider. Melatonin can disrupt your circadian rhythm further.
